leftEvidence.role: The mountain and those called blessed
leftEvidence.title: Teaching, healing, and crowds gather before the mountain

points.label: Event action and claim
points.left: Jesus teaches in Galilee, announces the Kingdom, heals disease, and becomes known across a wide region.
points.right: Seeing the crowds, Jesus goes up the mountain, sits, and receives his disciples.

points.label: Response and consequence
points.left: People bring the afflicted, Jesus heals them, and multitudes from several regions follow.
points.right: He opens his mouth and teaches them.

payload.posture: The antecedent explains the large following; the opening narrows attention to disciples around the seated teacher.

rightEvidence.role: The mountain and those called blessed
rightEvidence.title: Jesus sits and begins to teach

payload.tension: The discourse’s immediate and wider audiences remain visible without an invented movement.
payload.title: Crowds gather and disciples draw near
